title: 13 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Inflamed Mouth
intro: Herbal essential oils for inflamed mouth, also known as stomatitis, are natural extracts used to alleviate discomfort and inflammation in the mouth. The benefits of using herbal essential oils for this ailment include their antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to reduce pain and promote healing. Examples of herbal essential oils that can be used to treat inflamed mouth include tea tree oil, due to its antimicrobial properties, peppermint oil, which helps to reduce inflammation and soothe the mouth, eucalyptus oil, which has anti-inflammatory properties, and myrrh oil, which helps to reduce swelling and fight off infection. Additionally, oils like lavender oil and chamomile oil can be used to calm and soothe the mouth, while oils like ginger oil and turmeric oil have anti-inflammatory properties that can help to reduce pain and inflammation.
